## Summary

The NVFP4 checkpoints for Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, Qwen3.8-27B (FP4 head), GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash are published under the `nvidia` org on Hugging Face. This updates the cookbook to reference those instead of the RadixArk copies (existence of each `nvidia/*` repo verified via the HF API).

- Qwen3.8 / GLM-5.3 pages and config snippets: single reference points, straight swap to the `nvidia/*` repo ids.
- Qwen3.8-27B: the NVIDIA export is the same W4A4 body as the previous FP4-head entry (identical tensor set, 21.9 GB), so the duplicate `NVFP4-NVIDIA` quant option, its four per-card cells, and the extra model-table row merge into the FP4-head entry, which now points at `nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4`. Surrounding prose and sweep-count wording adjusted to match.
- GLM-5.3-Flash weights cell: deduplicated to list only `nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4`.

Left unchanged:
- `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-BF16-LMHead` and `RadixArk/Muse-Glimmer-NVFP4` — no `nvidia` counterpart exists.
- The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash RadixArk exports — these are distinct quantization artifacts documented side by side with NVIDIA's (different ModelOpt builds, separately measured benchmark rows), not mirrors.

## Verification

- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passes.
- Pre-commit passes.
- Grepped all remaining `RadixArk/*NVFP4` references in `docs/`: only the intentional keep-list above remains.

 Four cells are marked **Not Verified** — **GB300 BF16** and the three GB300 **DSpark** strategies. They have launch recipes but no completed validation run; every other cell on the page has been run, including B300 NVFP4 DSpark.
 
 **Weight size decides the topology.** At 2.4T parameters BF16 is ≈4.8TB, FP8 ≈2.4TB, NVFP4 ≈1.2TB. FP8 fits no single node here — not even B300, whose 8 × 288GB = 2.30TB misses by a hair — so every FP8 recipe is multi-node. Single-node means FP4: NVFP4 on B300, MXFP4 on MI355X/MI350X. B200 NVFP4 would fit one node but pipelines two, because ~25GB per GPU after weights is too little to serve against. BF16 does not fit 16 GPUs either, so its one recipe is TP32 across 8 GB300 nodes — the only platform where a flat TP32 stays on rack-scale NVLink.
 
-**Two distinct FP4 checkpoints.** [NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/RadixArk/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-NVFP4) is Blackwell-only; [MXFP4](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-FP8-MXFP4) is MI350X/MI355X-only and hybrid (MXFP4 experts, FP8 attention/dense). MI300X is CDNA3 with no hardware MX matmul, so it serves FP8. Leave `--moe-runner-backend` unset on both and the runner resolves from the checkpoint's own `quant_method` — except the NVFP4 wide-EP tier, which pairs `flashinfer_trtllm_routed` with `--moe-a2a-backend flashinfer` by hand because auto cannot resolve that combination.
+**Two distinct FP4 checkpoints.** [NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-NVFP4) is Blackwell-only; [MXFP4](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-FP8-MXFP4) is MI350X/MI355X-only and hybrid (MXFP4 experts, FP8 attention/dense).
